title: observability: token-level KV metrics/tracing dashboard + alert tuning for cost and latency
author: Maya Patel
description: Add token-level KV cache observability: new Grafana dashboard tiles for token-level cost and latency breakdowns, enhanced tracing spans for KV cache hits/misses, and tuned alerting rules to reduce noise while catching regressions. Motivation: customers running high-throughput generation observed unexplained cost spikes and tail latency tied to KV cache behavior. This PR provides visibility (per-route, per-model, per-token) and safer alert defaults. Changes include dashboard JSON, alert rule updates with aggregated and per-route thresholds, additional metrics emitted from the KV collector, tracing span additions, docs and rollout plan. Includes guardrails: feature-flagged rollout and optional sampling to limit ingestion. References: ENG-8123, SRE-231. Testing: unit + integration + load spike test in staging. Rollout: canary followed by full rollout once metrics stabilize.

release_notes: New token-level KV cache observability: dashboards showing per-token cost/latency breakdowns, improved KV tracing, and tuned alerts to reduce noise. Default rollout is feature-flagged; opt-in required for high-cardinality sampling.
testing: Staging: ran integration tests and load spike test (10k reqs/min) with sampling enabled to validate no metric cardinality explosion; observed 3% tail latency improvement on traced workload. Canary: 10% traffic for 24h, then progressive rollout. Post-merge: monitor token_kv_cost_per_token and kv_cache.hit_rate for 48h.
risk_assessment: low-medium. Metrics/tracing are additive; no runtime behavior changes except optional sampling guard which is opt-in. Alerts changed to be less sensitive to reduce noisy pages. Rollback: disable feature flag and revert alert rules via scripts/infra/update_alerts.sh.
rollout_plan: 1) Enable feature flag for observability team and run smoke tests. 2) Canary: enable for 10% of traffic for 24h, validate cost/latency dashboards. 3) Progressive rollout to 50% then 100% over 48h with ops checkpoints. 4) If noise increases, flip sampling or revert alerts using update_alerts.sh.
